info.title: AstraX External API
info.description: External listener contract only. Mandatory named bearer tokens and exact-origin CORS. Use TLS outside protected loopback transport. Public reads omit source/output URLs, stored credentials, process arguments and opaque operation results; diagnostic text is withheld. Management endpoints, token administration, events and web assets are not part of this contract. Select the actual configured external origin in your client, not the management origin. OPTIONS preflight is supported only for registered methods/paths and configured origins; Authorization and Content-Type are allowed, credentials mode is not. No external documentation assets or references are fetched.

parameters.name: requested_adapter
parameters.description: Single query value; unknown or duplicate parameters are rejected. Maximum 1024 decoded UTF-8 bytes. Omit for all requested adapters. Use auto for automatic assignment, the device key for a fixed assignment, or address:<adapter>.<frontend> (for example address:52.0) when the fixed assignment has no device key. A device key takes precedence over a saved address. Use keys from facets.requested_adapters; opaque device keys are matched exactly. The auto value and address: prefix are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: actual_adapter
parameters.description: Single query value; unknown or duplicate parameters are rejected. Maximum 1024 decoded UTF-8 bytes. Omit for all actual adapters. Use the runtime placement card ID, or unassigned for streams with no actual card ID. Use keys from facets.actual_adapters; card IDs are matched exactly. The unassigned value is case-insensitive; automatic requested assignment does not imply an actual placement.

post.description: Action-dependent scope: start/stop/restart require streams:control; move_group/assign_adapter/delete require admin. Requires action-dependent. No scope implicitly includes another. Inspect every result and succeeded/failed counts even on HTTP 200; partial failures are not retried automatically. ok:true and succeeded count mean the requested configuration change was persisted; they do not prove runtime activation or running/locked state. Activation can fail after persistence. Read GET /api/v1/dvb-streams or GET /api/v1/dvb-streams/{id} afterward to inspect runtime state.

get.description: Requires read on both management and external handlers. No scope implicitly includes another; tokens are not resource-scoped. Read-only cached metadata: no detector, tuner opener, ECM submission, network access or pipeline startup. No query parameters are accepted. Unattached candidates are an explicit empty array; identity and policy may be null. No source/output URLs, credentials, raw CA bytes, keys or leases are exposed. External API enabled controls listener binding, not direct in-process handler authorization.

dvb_descrambling.description: Optional descrambling policy. Omitted or null means disabled. Disabled policies may be incomplete. The sole profile reference is top-level softcam_id; nested profile or credential fields are rejected. Enabling requires a complete policy, the referenced enabled native CCcam/Newcamd profile and an available CSA backend. Backend-unavailable builds reject enable; a saved policy is not proof of runtime descrambling.

enabled.description: Absent or null is false; no automatic enable.

algorithm.description: Enabling requires exactly dvb-csa after trimming. Disabled policies may omit this value or retain an incomplete or unsupported algorithm.

caid.description: Nonempty trimmed values must contain exactly four hexadecimal digits and are saved uppercase. Empty, null or omitted is allowed while disabled; enabling requires a value.

provider.description: Nonempty trimmed values must contain exactly six hexadecimal digits and are saved uppercase, including explicit 000000. Empty, null or omitted is allowed while disabled; enabling requires an explicit value.

ecm_pid.description: Optional override; omitted or null is no override, distinct from PID zero. Enabled policies require 1..8190 when supplied. Disabled policies may retain any integer; the enabled range is not applied while disabled.

InputDVBStreamConfig.description: Canonical delivery tokens dvbs/dvbs2/dvbc/dvbt/dvbt2 (single-hyphen DVB aliases accepted). Frequency in kHz, symbol rate in symbols/s; satellite requires symbol rate and H/V polarization (horizontal/vertical aliases accepted, trimmed and case-insensitive). Stream service_id 1..65535; scans may use 0. Backend capability checks still apply.

InputAdapterLNBConfig.description: LOF1/LOF2/SLOF and slot_frequency are MHz. Modes include universal, unicable1 and unicable2. Unicable slots are one-based. RF values are normalized/validated by the backend.

InputDVBAdapterPolicy.description: Auto or fixed assignment. Fixed requires device_key or last_address. Auto must not use fallback last_address 0.0.

output_template.description: Required template; supports {sid}, {name}, {provider}, {index} (one-based selected-request order). Literal output paths also accepted. Credential-bearing template is write-only.

ids.description: Include every editable group exactly once, in the desired order. Exclude the synthetic Ungrouped entry (empty ID); partial lists, duplicate IDs and unknown IDs are rejected.
